1.w: Therefore I exhort you⁺, brothers, through the compassions of God, to present your⁺ bodies [as] a living sacrifice, holy to God, well-pleasing, which is your⁺ reasonable service.

2.w: And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of the mind, for you⁺ to discern what [is] the good and well-pleasing and perfect will of God.

3.w: For through the grace having been given to me, I say to everyone being among you⁺ not to be high-minded above what it is necessary to think, but to think so as to be sound-minded, as God allotted to each a measure of faith.

4.w: For just as in one body we have many members, and not all the members have the same function,

5.w: so we, the many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

6.w: And we are having different gifts according to the grace having been given to us: if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;

7.w: and if service, in the service; and if teaching, in the teaching;

8.w: and if exhorting, in the exhortation; giving, in generosity; leading, in diligence; showing mercy, in cheerfulness.

9.w: [Let] love [be] unfeigned: abhorring evil, cleaving to good,

10.w: devoted to one another in brotherly love, esteeming one another in honor,

11.w: not slothful in diligence, being fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

12.w: rejoicing in hope, enduring in tribulation, persisting in prayer,

13.w: contributing to the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.

14.w: Bless those persecuting you⁺; bless and do not curse,

15.w: to rejoice with the rejoicing, to weep with the weeping,

16.w: minding the same thing toward one another, not minding the high [things], but going along with the lowly. Do not be wise in yourselves,

17.w: repaying to no one evil for evil, giving forethought to right [things] before all men;

18.w: if possible of you⁺, being at peace with all men;

19.w: not avenging yourselves, beloved; but give place to wrath, for it has been written: “Vengeance [is] Mine, I will repay, says the Lord.”

20.w: Rather, “If your enemy should hunger, feed him; if he should thirst, give him a drink; for doing this, you will heap coals of fire upon his head.”

21.w: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil in good.
